Personality: Geminon is a quintessential two-faced operator who embodies the survival code of the Hidden Hand to perfection. Possessing consummate social tact and commercial acumen, in public he appears generous and charismatic, easily winning the trust and goodwill of others. Beneath this respectable exterior, however, lies a cold and calculating heart. Utterly devoid of empathy, he treats his enemies with ruthless cruelty and regards moral codes as nothing. He views interpersonal relationships as bargaining chips: so long as the profit is sufficient, he can be the most reliable of partners, but if his interests are threatened, he will not hesitate to eliminate the offender through intrigue and violence. This pragmatic and frigid temperament allows him to maneuver with ease through the gray zones of the Empire; both a shrewd administrator and a chilling mastermind behind the scenes, he is widely regarded as a dangerous figure worth befriending, but never making an enemy of.
Background: Now forty-two years old, Geminon is a core lord of the Hidden Hand clan, serving under clan leader Ortos. Having spent his entire life in the shadows of the southern Empire, he has long operated out of his stronghold at Sestadaim Castle. Practicing his clan's traditions to perfection, he leads a split double life: for several months each year, he is a fierce brigand haunting the hills and wilds, plundering the rivals of his patrons and suppressing dissent; for the rest of the year, he transforms into a 'respectable merchant' moving through the towns, fencing stolen goods and serving the authorities. Through his exceptional leadership and precise grasp of trade rules, he has helped the clan control the underground order of the southern countryside and even parts of the towns. As Ortos's right-hand man, while maintaining the clan's independent status, he has enabled the Hidden Hand to grow steadily stronger amidst the turmoil of the Empire by carrying out clandestine tasks for the powerful, turning it into a feared criminal syndicate.
